newsitem.title: USA: Sun Communities offers Chateau cash option.
newsitem.headline: Sun Communities offers Chateau cash option.

text.p: Sun Communities Inc said on Wednesday it offered Chateau Properties Inc a cash alternative to its existing stock-swap merger proposal.

"We are flexible with respect to both the structure of the combination and the type of consideration offered," Sun said in a letter to Chateau's board of directors. "We are prepared to provide a cash alternative to the extent desired by your shareholders."

Chateau, a Michigan-based real estate investment trust, has already signed a definitive agreement to merge with ROC Communities Inc but said last week it was continuing to consider unsolicited takeover proposals.

Sun said it previously offered the real estate investment trust 0.892 share of Sun Communities for each share of Chateau common stock, a value of $25.87 per share of Chateau based on Sun's September 11 closing price of $29 per share.
A number of Chateau shareholders subsequently told Sun they preferred the Sun merger offer, Sun said.
Manufactured Home Communities Inc MCH.N said last week it launched a $26-per-share tender offer for Chateau worth almost $400 million, sweetening an earlier stock offer worth $21 per share.

"While we believe our existing stock-for-stock proposal provides a superior upside potential and long-term value relative to the MHC offer and ROC merger, we are wiling to consider a cash alternative which compares favorably with MHC's offer," Sun wrote to Chateau.
